# Sailing Naturali

> A tech exec is using AI leverage to build a premium all-electric sailing charter in the Pacific Northwest — the kind of business AI can't deliver. Follow the build.

## Pages

- [Sailing Naturali — an all-electric charter, built with AI](https://sailingnaturali.com): A tech exec is using AI leverage to build a premium all-electric sailing charter in the Pacific Northwest — the kind of business AI can't deliver. Follow the build.
- [Itineraries — Sailing Naturali](https://sailingnaturali.com/itineraries): The charter trips we’re planning aboard an all-electric catamaran in the Pacific Northwest — a Gulf Islands loop, a Desolation Sound expedition, a Sunshine Coast passage, and the far-north Broughtons. In development.
